auth.welcomeSub: Ushobora gushakisha ingendo utabanje kwiyandikisha. Injira kugira ngo utange urugendo cyangwa ubuke intebe.

role.bothDesc: Rimwe na rimwe ndatwara, rimwe na rimwe ndagenzwa

auth.termsHint: Ufungura konti wemera amategeko ya TUJYANE.
auth.passwordHint: Nibura inyuguti 8. Vanga inyuguti, imibare n'ibimenyetso.

cookie.title: Dukoresha cookies
cookie.body: TUJYANE ikoresha cookies kugira ngo ikomeze kukuzi no gusobanukirwa uko porogaramu ikoreshwa.

landing.heroValueProp: Shakisha intebe cyangwa utange izawe mu Rwanda hose. Ku giciro cy'ukuri, hifashishijwe abemewe, mu mafaranga yawe.
landing.browseHint: Ntugomba konti kugira ngo urebe — uzayifungura gusa igihe usaba cyangwa utanga urugendo.

how.title: Uko bikora
how.step1Body: Hitamo aho utangirira n'aho ugana — dukubwira igiciro cy'ukuri kuri buri ntebe hakurikijwe intera n'imodoka.
how.step2Body: Ohereza icyifuzo cy'intebe. Umushoferi aremera, hanyuma uhabwa kode y'ibanga y'imibare 4.
how.step3Body: Ku munsi w'urugendo, wereka umushoferi kode. Ayemeza — icyo ni ikimenyetso cy'uko winjiye.

landing.corridorsSub: Ingendo zishakishwa cyane muri iki cyumweru.

trust.title: Ishingiye ku kwizerana
trust.sub: Buri kirinzi cy'umutekano gikora buri gihe.
trust.verifiedBody: Buri mushoferi, indangamuntu ye, uruhushya n'inyandiko z'imodoka birebwa n'umuntu mbere y'urugendo rwe rwa mbere.
trust.codeBody: Buri buke bwemewe buhabwa kode y'ibanga y'imibare 4. Nta kode, nta rugendo.
trust.ratingsBody: Abashoferi n'abagenzi bahererekanya amanota nyuma ya buri rugendo. Izina ryiza ryunguka.
trust.fairBody: Sisitemu ibara igiciro cy'ukuri buri ntebe. Umushoferi ntahita ashyiraho igiciro kidakwiye.

drive.title: Hindura intebe zisigaye amafaranga yo kunywa lisansi.
drive.body: Tanga urugendo mu munota. Emera abagenzi ushatse, komera imodoka yawe — kandi ubone ubufasha bwa lisansi.
